regions.merged_text: Stephen J. Hook 65, 4525 Avery, Enrolled August 10th as against cancer on nose reports To-day as improving before reaching home, has not bothered him since, going away gradually. To-day enrol- led again as against head-aches. Sept. 26 Now completely cured - just a weak scar left. Oct. 14, 1933 Same Mr. Hook was burried yesterday -+0ct. 10 - hardening of arteries.
